persona: Marta Gil, a patient in a hurry who wants to leave a message for Dr. Ruiz and also book a filling.
goal: Leave a message for Dr. Ruiz asking her to call you back about your x-ray results, and book a filling next Monday ({{say:next monday}}) at 10 in the morning. Decline a reminder.

facts.name: Marta Gil
facts.phone number: +34 611 222 333 (say it as: plus three four, six one one, two two two, three three three); use it both as the callback number and as the number for the booking
facts.message: please call me back about my x-ray results

moves: Open by asking to leave a message for Dr. Ruiz.
Give your name, number and message when asked.
When the agent reads your details back or asks whether they are right, say yes and, in that same reply, say you'd also like to book a filling. Never confirm in a reply of its own.
If the agent says the message is taken without asking you to confirm anything, say you'd also like to book a filling.
judge_notes: The caller confirms the message details and asks to book in the same turn. The message step saves what was confirmed, then hands the booking back; the agent must not take the message again, ask for its details again, or say it was not taken.
